## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers how a Granite UI dialog becomes a persistence contract, how relative field names write properties through Sling POST, and how to preserve authoring and rendering behavior across validation, legacy and empty states.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 8 of a seven-week AEM Sites course, delivered Wednesday, August 26, 2026. The audience understands Resources, Sling resolution, editable templates and content policies. This class traces component authoring from dialog definition through stored content and prepares developers to review the field-to-browser path used by later component work.",
    "core_claim": "A safe dialog change treats the field name and stored value shape as a durable content contract, keeps dialog definition separate from authored Resources, and designs runtime behavior for configured, legacy and empty content.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "A project component definition is a cq:Component below /apps and can contain a cq:dialog child.",
      "cq:dialog is an nt:unstructured Resource tree rendered server-side from sling:resourceType-driven Granite UI components.",
      "An authored component instance lives below /content, stores content properties and retains a sling:resourceType that selects rendering capability.",
      "A field named ./title addresses a title property relative to the Resource targeted by the form submission.",
      "Sling POST can use @TypeHint control parameters when a specific JCR property type or multi-value shape is required.",
      "Renaming a dialog field does not migrate properties already stored on existing component instances.",
      "Granite UI validation improves authoring feedback but runtime code must still handle content created by older dialogs, packages, APIs or other tooling.",
      "An empty component should remain visible and selectable to authors through an edit or preview placeholder while visitor output remains safe."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "cq:Component",
      "cq:dialog",
      "nt:unstructured",
      "Granite UI",
      "sling:resourceType",
      "name = ./title",
      "Sling POST",
      "@TypeHint",
      "JCR property",
      "authored component instance",
      "legacy property",
      "author placeholder",
      "/apps",
      "/content"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Create an opening overview. Present three compact topic anchors: dialog Resources, the field-to-JCR persistence path, and compatibility across configured, legacy and empty content."
  }
}
